channel.title: Twilio incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Twilio's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Voice Call Audio Quality Degradation from a Subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to Germany [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call audio quality degradation from a subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to network subscribers in Germany. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Megafon Tajikistan [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Megafon network subscribers in Tajikistan. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Tigo Honduras [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from Twilio to Tigo network subscribers in Honduras is operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to AT&T Mexico [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from Twilio to AT&T network subscribers in Mexico is operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Nex-Tech Wireless LLC United States [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery receipt delays from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to Nex-Tech Wireless LLC network subscribers in the United States. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. Message delivery may succeed, but delivery receipts may be delayed. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: Automated Alert: No Customer Impact [resolved]
item.description: We have fully investigated the potential issue with Status-Callback Service triggered by our automated alert, and it was determined that there is no noticeable customer impact. All systems are operational.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio Phone Numbers to Robi Bangladesh [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from Twilio Phone Numbers to Robi network subscribers in Bangladesh is operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio to Telefonica Spain [resolved]
item.description: This Incident has been resolved as we observed recovery and stablity in SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio to Telefonica Network in Spain.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to MTN Congo [resolved]
item.description: This Incident has been resolved as observed metrics recovered and stable for SMS delivery from Twilio to MTN network subscribers in Congo

item.title: MMS Delivery Delays and Failures from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Multiple Networks in United States [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and MMS delivery between a subset of Twilio Short Codes to network subscribers on affected networks in the United States is operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from Twilio to Mauritel Mauritania [resolved]

item.title: SMS Delivery Failures from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Multiple Networks in India [resolved]

item.title: User Authentication Identity Gateway API Failure Increase for Pacificeast in United States [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and User Authentication Identity Gateway API failure increase for Pacificeast in the United States is operating normally.

item.title: Voice Call Failures from a Subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to Switzerland [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and voice calls from a subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to network subscribers in Switzerland are operating normally.

item.title: Interconnection Infrastructure Upgrade (SG1 – Edge2 Switch) [maintenance]
item.description: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery receipts from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile network subscribers in the United States are operating normally.

item.description: Our engineers have monitored the issue and confirmed the issue with email deliveries to Microsoft has recovered to normal levels. All services are now operating normally at this time.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to MobiFone Vietnam [resolved]

Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: Retroactive Incident: Twilio Personalized Support Phone Line Affected [resolved]
item.description: Intermittent dropped calls were reported on the Twilio personalized support hotline between 2026-08-24 08:10 AM PT and 2026-09-01 10:27 AM PT. The root cause was identified as a bug within Twilio Studio. A patch has been applied, and service has been fully restored.

item.title: Unable to Login to Console [resolved]
